why: W15h (22 Oct 2026): the one home of the CI signing certificate SHA-256 (DER, lower-case hex). Since W15g (31 Oct 2026) the Sign job stops before apksigner when the keystore certificate differs (src/build/sign_apk.py, artifact_identity.check_keystore_pin) and again when the signed APK's signer differs, and docs/obtainium.json pins it as allowedSigningCertHashes, so Obtainium 1.6.16 or newer refuses an APK signed by any other key. Changing this value is a key rotation: every phone must re-import from the page (RECOVERY.md).
